propositions: Handing a resumption attempt the prior attempt's search frontier as a data-shaped exclusion list inside an untrusted fence does not reduce re-search overlap compared to cache-seeded resume alone (control and treatment arms show increased overlap rates on both test tickets, failing the predeclared GO threshold of >=30% relative reduction).
The frontier block rendered inert by fence design or acted as a signpost, causing the model to re-read already-searched files in order, raising measured overlap rather than reducing it.

The cache-seeding mechanism (verdict cache for credited criteria) already removes dominant redundancy; the remaining re-grounding of unproven criteria cannot be suppressed by data-shaped evidence inside an untrusted fence.

Argument-level tool-call transcripts (paths, patterns, resolve_symbol calls) were not carried by verifier telemetry and had to be captured harness-side; production would require persisting these transcripts per (ticket, run) to enable empirical overlap analysis.
